nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used as allowance owner, sender and owner check in StandardToken.
Transaction origin used in transferFrom to bypass allowance approval (state[tx.origin] == 0).
Public mapping of account balances, updated with unchecked arithmetic.
Mapping used to whitelist/unlock addresses, checked with tx.origin in transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping, decreased unchecked in transferFrom.
Privileged owner address set from msg.sender in the constructor.
Derived Uniswap pair address used as the fee-triggering recipient.
Hardcoded external fee-management library address invoked via external call.
Total token supply assigned to the deployer at construction.
Public payable transfer entrypoint mixing allowance logic, tx.origin bypass and unchecked balance math.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, to, value).
Private fee computation that performs an external call to FeeManagementLibrary when sending to UNI.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only batch transfer loop with unchecked multiplication and division.
Public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Payable fallback that silently accepts ether.
Sets owner, metadata, supply, unlimited allowance and derived UNI pair.
SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level call to a token and decoding optional return data.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary external code in the contract context.
address(token).call(data) low-level external call forwarding arbitrary calldata.
External call to the hardcoded FeeManagementLibrary contract during fee calculation.
Unchecked subtraction/multiplication/division on balances (no SafeMath in StandardToken).
_from address parameter of transferFrom.
_to address parameter of transferFrom.
_value amount parameter of transferFrom.
Local fee variable assigned from calcFee in transferFrom.
Target address parameter of delegate.
Arbitrary calldata bytes parameter of delegate.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Local total computed as _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Encoded calldata passed into callOptionalReturn.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as allowance owner and compared against _from in transferFrom.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the source of the delegated transferFrom.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate gates execution with require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend gates execution with require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants unlimited allowance.
tx.origin is used in state[tx.origin] == 0 to skip the allowance deduction path.
transferFrom invokes calcFee before completing its own accounting semantics.
calcFee performs an external call to the FeeManagement library with user-controlled value.
calcFee reads the hardcoded FeeManagement address for the external call.
The external library call can re-enter transferFrom while balances are mid-update.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked += / -=.
Balance and allowance updates in transferFrom use raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom consults state[tx.origin] mapping before allowance logic.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is executed without SafeMath.
batchSend iterates over the caller-supplied recipient array.
total = _value * _tos.length can overflow without SafeMath.
batchSend mutates balances and computes _value/2 with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend adds to balanceOf[_to] for each recipient without SafeMath.
batchSend marks each recipient in the state whitelist mapping.
delegate forwards attacker-supplied calldata into an arbitrary delegatecall target.
Delegatecalled code executes in this contract's storage context.
The delegatecall target address is the user-supplied parameter a.
The delegatecall calldata is the user-supplied parameter b.
callOptionalReturn forwards encodeWithSelector data into a low-level call.
The called token contract can re-enter before return data is validated.
Parameter data is the exact payload passed to the low-level call.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender/spender.
constructor sets owner from msg.sender.
constructor derives and stores the UNI pair address.
constructor assigns totalSupply from the deployment parameter.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
_from parameter drives debit/allowance logic in transferFrom.
_to parameter determines the credited account in transferFrom.
_value parameter flows directly into unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Local fee receives the result of the external FeeManagement call inside transferFrom.
fee is subtracted from _value before crediting the recipient balance.
_tos array bounds the batchSend loop and its recipients.
Local total is used for the balance sufficiency check in batchSend.
